### 1\. Installing Operating Systems

#### a. Windows 10 Installation (Target)

\- Before you install Windows 10, you have to install media creation tool from: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/software-download/windows10  
![][image1]  
\- Then, double click the file and run it. And accept all the license terms.  
![][image2]  
\- After this, select create installation media option and continue.

![][image3]  
 \- Keep the language and region setting as default.  
![][image4]  
\- Choose iso file option so that you can use iso file to download windows 10\.  
![][image5]

\- Wait for it to download to 100%  
![][image6]  
\- In virtual machine, select new and keep the file location and proceed with unattended installation same as default, and mount the iso file for windows 10   
![][image7]  
\- The Virtual hardware is set as shown below and keeps the virtual hard disk as 50.00 MB.![][image8]  
\- After this installation starts, keep the language and region setting as default as shown below:  
![][image9]  
\- Choose I do not have a product key option and agree to license agreements.  
![][image10]  
![][image11]  
\- After that, choose Custom: Install Windows only (advanced) option and then choose Drive Unallocated space for installation![][image12]  
\- And then leave windows 10 for installation. It will automatically install.  
![][image13]  
Note: Do not press any key after the download is complete.

#### b. Windows Server Installation (Target)

\- For downloading windows server 2022 iso file, visit this site: [https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/evalcenter/download-windows-server-2022](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/evalcenter/download-windows-server-2022)  
\- Choose a 64 bit iso file for windows and download it.  
![][image14]  
![][image15]

\- I named my machines as Windows Server and unchecked the procceed with unattended installation.  
![][image16]  
\- I chose the memory as 4096 and 1 core main CPU.  
![][image17]  
\- I choose 50 MB as a storage and then clicked finished.  
![][image18]  
\- After that I powered on the machine and kept region, language setting as default.  
![][image19]  
\- After that I clicked the Install Now option and chose second option of windows server desktop edition to get the GUI.  
![][image20]  
\- Accepted the license Agreement.  
![][image21]

\- Chose second option of Custom Install Microsoft Server Operating System only (advanced) and kept the disc space as default.  
![][image22]  
![][image23]

\- After that, windows server started installing and you must wait for sometime to complete it  
![][image24]
